en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a historic European town with densely packed tiled roofs, narrow streets, and multiple church towers. In the foreground is a tall baroque-style church tower rising from a large roofed building in the town center. To the left, on a wooded hillside, stands a complex that looks like a small castle or monastery with two Romanesque-style towers. Beyond the town are rolling hills, fields, and scattered villages, giving a picturesque valley setting. No visible printed caption or text appears on the front.
